risk: Connected app blocked: since Sep 2025 users can't authorize uninstalled connected apps without 'Approve Uninstalled Connected Apps'; since Spring '26 new connected apps can't be created by default

risk: Agent consumes org-wide daily API quota (EE: 100k + 1k per license, pooled, rolling 24h), breaking customer's other integrations

risk: Integration User license grants zero object access; missing field-level security makes data silently absent (no error)

risk: Full sandbox refresh only every 29 days (Partial 5, Dev 1); test data stale or unavailable

risk: Shield probabilistic encryption blocks WHERE/filter on encrypted fields (e.g. phone), breaking caller lookup

risk: Validation rules/required fields/flows reject agent writes that pass in UI

risk: Security team blocks OAuth after Salesloft Drift token theft (Aug 2025, 700+ orgs reported)

risk: CDC/platform events retained only 72h; missed events unrecoverable after outage

risk: Prompt injection via Web-to-Lead exfiltrates CRM data to expired allowlisted domain (ForcedLeak, CVSS 9.4)

risk: Rate limit: private app 190/10s, marketplace OAuth app 110/10s per account; daily 625k-1M; 429s under burst
mitigation: Batch APIs; backoff on 429; budget per account

risk: Legacy public apps can't be created after Jun 23 2026; new static-auth private apps install in one account only; manual migration

risk: Workflow webhooks don't retry on 4xx; events lost on validation error

risk: Service protection: 6,000 req / 5 min / user, 1,200 s exec time, 52 concurrent; 429 with Retry-After

risk: FHIR Appointment create needs Slot reference; booking against order-role slots unsupported

risk: Production needs Marketplace partner approval + security review + per-practice authorization; fees/rev share unpublished

risk: Low preview/sandbox rate limits (5-20 calls/s; token 5/min) make load tests unrepresentative

risk: Sandbox sold separately; refresh ~2 days; must activate within 14 days

risk: 6,000 req/5 min per user/SP, 5 concurrent (rest queued), 100 connections then 429, 8-min timeout

risk: Webhook circuit breaker stops delivery to failing endpoint; agent misses events

risk: Platform-side DB lock caused bots to repeat messages after human reply (Jul 2026)

risk: Change Advisory Board approval and freeze windows gate go-live and every config change

risk: Instance clone overwrites sub-prod integration credentials/endpoints and loses in-progress update sets

risk: Inbound REST rate-limit rules (strictest wins; counts commit every 30s) throttle agent

risk: Booking-rate metric unreliable when calls unclassified; baseline wrong

risk: MFA on the legacy UI blocks unattended automation

risk: No written acceptance criteria -> endless pilot (Gartner: 40%+ agentic projects cancelled by 2027 over unclear value)
